Description: Mallobaudes is a western Roman military figure of Frankish origin. He is concerned with how followers of different origins can accept one chain of command. He values ties formed in service and resists being treated solely as the spokesman of one ethnic group. Maintaining support requires service he can actually provide, while followers need food, reward and safety. An order that reserves glory for its author and blame for its executor makes him wary. He wants his judgement heard before a decision rather than being given responsibility only after it fails.
